commit.message:
Address review: name node-cost constant, add fudge margin and debug assert, add worst-case test

Lift the per-argument node estimate into a named constant
(estimated_nodes_per_concat_arg) in stringopts.hpp, subtract
NodeLimitFudgeFactor from the budget for margin, and add a debug assert
that a replacement does not create more than num_arguments * estimate
nodes. Add TestWorstCaseIntConcat, which forces the unknown-coder path
(both Latin1 and UTF16 digit loops) to exercise the worst-case int
expansion.
